tool.title: Translation adjudication workflow (reusable)
tool.description: The tools layer's reusable `layer-translation-adjudication.yml`, called by a layer on `issues` events: runs once per issue labelled `translation-adjudication` or titled `[translation review] …`, mounts the platform's layers, runs `translation:adjudicate` on the event, and either commits the records on `translation-adjudication/issue-<n>` (authored by the issue's author) and opens a ready PR, or comments why nothing was recorded. It never merges.

inputs.name: path_in_repo
inputs.description: Where the layer sits in the calling repository; `.` for the root.

inputs.name: index_ref
inputs.description: The folio-assistant ref whose lock mounts the platform's layers. Default `main`.

inputs.name: tools_ref
inputs.description: `lock` (the caller's lock pin of the tools layer) or a 40-hex commit.

outputs.name: pull_request
outputs.description: The ready PR carrying the records, when anything was recorded.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: The comment on the issue: what was recorded and what was refused.

remedies.none: It is a GitHub Actions workflow; it runs on GitHub or not at all. `translation-adjudicate` plans and writes the same records in a checkout, given the event file.

$comment.comment: `manual`, honestly: a reusable workflow is not dispatched; a layer's caller (`on: issues`, `uses: <tools layer>/.github/workflows/layer-translation-adjudication.yml@<lock sha>`) runs it when an issue is filed. The `ig-folio-site-workflow` node is the precedent for a node over a workflow.
